missionSettings.description: FAULT LINE 4/5 - MEUSE CROSSING. The North strikes back in the east. From Sint-Truiden, Tongeren and the Voeren, three columns push south on the southern line north of Liege, with the crossing at Vise as the prize. Rocket artillery near Bilzen covers them. The South holds the line and has a reserve in Seraing. NORTH: break 70% of the southern line. SOUTH: destroy 75% of the three columns. Both sides playable: PvP, or co-op against the AI. Requires NOCustomMaps and the Belgica map (Nuclear Option Mod Manager). Fictional scenario: North = Boscali, South = Primeva. No nuclear weapons.

objectives.DisplayName: Break the southern line north of Liege

outcomes.Message: First column away from Sint-Truiden, heading south-east.
Second column out of Tongeren, driving on Bassenge.
Third column out of the Voeren, going for the crossing at Vise.
The southern line has broken. Northern armour is across at Vise.
The northern offensive has stalled on the plateau. Liege holds.
The Seraing reserve is moving up to Herstal. Cover it.
North, the counter-offensive begins. Cover the columns and get us across the Meuse.
South, northern armour is moving out of Limburg. Hold the line north of Liege.
Hit them at the crossings, and find the rocket artillery near Bilzen.
